THIS WEEK IN LOCAL GOVERNMENT

The Weston Village Board approved a $6.7 million contract to build a new Mountain Bay Metropolitan Police Department facility, and residents heard that DC Everest schools may ask voters to approve an $81–94 million referendum as soon as April 2027.

  • The Weston Village Board voted 7-0 to award the Mountain Bay Metro Police Department building contract to 8 Pine Inc. for $6.7 million, under a $7 million budget.
  • DC Everest school district leaders presented Weston trustees with a long-range facility plan that could include an $81–94 million referendum on the April 2027 ballot.
  • The Kronenwetter Parks Committee recommended the village board approve a $5,000 matching grant and sanction a September 12 Bushka Park 5K/3K Run-Walk as an official village event.
  • Weston's Finance and Human Resources Committee recommended board approval of a renewed 36-month Cintas uniform agreement and a one-year audit contract extension with Hawkins Ash.
  • The Kronenwetter Plan Commission is set to consider a zoning change for Marathon County Highway Department property from business and agricultural to M2 General Industrial, plus a conditional use permit for a residential pond.

Coming up: The Marathon County Board meets Tuesday, July 28, for its full county board session, and the Kronenwetter Village Board meets Monday, July 27, at 6 p.m. where it is set to act on the Marathon County Highway Facility rezone and the Happy Hollow Road subdivision map.
